    • id

      public StartConversationRequest.Builder id(String id)
      Sets the conversation ID (required).

      Can be anything consisting of letters, numbers, or any of the following characters: _ - + =

      Tip: use something meaningful to your business (e.g. a ticket number).

      Parameters:
      id - the conversation ID
      Returns:
      this builder

      public StartConversationRequest.Builder assigneeType(ParticipantType assigneeType)
      Sets the type of participant currently assigned to respond (optional).

      Set this to ParticipantType.AI_AGENT to assign the conversation to the Gradient Labs AI when starting it.

    • conversationToken

      public StartConversationRequest.Builder conversationToken(String conversationToken)
      Sets a sensitive token for the conversation (optional).

      The latest token will be echoed back in future webhooks under the header X-GradientLabs-Token, as well as in HTTP tools using templates.

      Parameters:
      conversationToken - the conversation token
      Returns:
      this builder

    • trafficGroupId

      public StartConversationRequest.Builder trafficGroupId(String trafficGroupId)
      Sets the traffic group ID (optional).

      Restricts the conversation to only access procedures assigned to the specified traffic group, plus any procedures not assigned to any group.

      Parameters:
      trafficGroupId - the traffic group ID
      Returns:
      this builder

    • customerSupportPlatformIdentifiers

      public StartConversationRequest.Builder customerSupportPlatformIdentifiers(List<CustomerSupportPlatformIdentifier> customerSupportPlatformIdentifiers)
      Sets the customer's identifiers in third-party customer support platforms (optional).

      Links the customer being created to their record(s) in platforms such as Intercom or Zendesk, alongside customerId. Each identifier's type is only required (and only validated) for intercom, zendesk, and salesforce.

      Parameters:
      customerSupportPlatformIdentifiers - the customer support platform identifiers
      Returns:
      this builder
